I can't call that safe or unsafe for you, and I won't promise it gets you there faster. Three hours a day is a lot of volume. Most people can't recover from it, and it tends to end in burnout, a stalled routine or an overuse problem. If you have any health condition, or want to know whether that load is right for your body, check with a doctor first.

Weight loss comes mostly from how you eat, with training you can keep up week after week supporting it. A routine you can repeat for months will beat a heroic one you drop in three weeks. If you tell me your goal and how many days you can train, I'll build you a plan around it.
